# Histogram (`histogram`)

Luminance / RGB histogram.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createHistogram` (types in `dist/web/charts/histogram.d.ts`): `.mh-histogram`: a luminance and / or RGB histogram. Luminance is drawn in the muted text colour, the colour channels in the theme's danger, success and info colours, translucent so overlaps show. Markers flag clipped shadows and highlights (1% or more of the pixels in the end bins).

```ts
export function createHistogram(options: HistogramOptions): HistogramHandle;

export interface HistogramOptions {
  data: HistogramData;
  /** What it shows ("Snapshot histogram"); a description of the tones is added for screen readers. */
  label: string;
  /** Which channels to draw: `luminance`, `rgb` or `all`; default every channel in `data`. */
  mode?: 'luminance' | 'rgb' | 'all';
  scale?: HistogramScale;
  /** Markers at the ends when shadows or highlights are clipped (default true). */
  clipping?: boolean;
  size?: ChartSize;
}

export interface HistogramHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: HistogramOptions): void;
}

/** Bin counts per channel, darkest bin first (any number of bins, usually 256). */
export type HistogramData = Partial<Record<HistogramChannel, readonly number[]>>;
```

`histogramFromPixels` (types in `dist/web/charts/histogram.d.ts`): Bins RGBA pixel data (as from a canvas, 0–255 per byte) into per-channel histograms. Luminance uses the Rec. 709 weights on the stored values.

```ts
export function histogramFromPixels(rgba: ArrayLike<number>, bins = 256): Required<HistogramData>;
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createHistogram, histogramFromPixels } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const image = new Image();
image.src = 'snapshot.jpg';

const histogram = createHistogram({ data: {}, label: 'Snapshot histogram', mode: 'rgb' });

// Count the image's pixels once it has loaded.
image.addEventListener('load', () => {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = image.naturalWidth;
  canvas.height = image.naturalHeight;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  if (!context) return;
  context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
  const pixels = context.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data;
  histogram.update({ data: histogramFromPixels(pixels, 64), label: 'Snapshot histogram', mode: 'rgb' });
});

document.body.append(histogram.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState, type SyntheticEvent } from 'react';
import { Histogram } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { histogramFromPixels, type HistogramData } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function HistogramExample() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<HistogramData>({});
  // Count the image's pixels once it has loaded.
  const measure = (event: SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement>) => {
    const image = event.currentTarget;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = image.naturalWidth;
    canvas.height = image.naturalHeight;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!context) return;
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    setData(histogramFromPixels(context.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data, 64));
  };
  return (
    <>
      <img src="snapshot.jpg" alt="Garden snapshot" width={320} onLoad={measure} />
      <Histogram data={data} label="Snapshot histogram" mode="rgb" />
    </>
  );
}
```
